note: Offline expectations only - no replay has been run (a replay is billed, the user's word first). The scaffold is a small orders service whose docs root carries one architecture preference (A1) and one code weakness (W1), with ALFRED_CODE_SCORING=1 in settings.local.json, and the task asks for an implementation plan, so the plan writer drafts a designer-plan the loop must grade before it reaches work/plans/. Five things are graded on what the run DID: the grade comes from an output-scoring seat, no plan reaches work/plans/ before the script's first `next`, no plan reaches it after a NOT PASSED line until a later release line, nor while a fix-on-pass offer waits on its answer, and answers.md is written at most once (attempt 2 is the last). The 'no ask of the producer after a withhold' half is not graded offline (R12): the continue ask is itself an AskUserQuestion. grade-after-return reads a `grade ... && ... next` in ONE Bash command as next after grade (the 2026-11-04 smoke's shape on both arms; the old first-index order missed it), and a next with no grade before it, or a next ahead of the grade in one command, as a fail. The fixtures/ folder holds the 25 calibration cases graded by the seat itself (Task 14 Step 5), not by this file. PF1: the three plan-status steps grade the after arm (plan folders, the script installed); the before arm (3.11.0, flat plans, no script) reads them as - ticks-through-plan-status passes when no stamp is hand-written into a plan; status-json-never-edited and approved-plan-never-edited pass with nothing to edit, and are WORSE only when the after arm edits one.
